scope: Inbound uses owned Telnyx E.164 origination and registration into Connect; outbound additionally reaches a separate Vapi-managed E.164 receiver outside the owned Telnyx account. The backing carrier of that receiver is not asserted.
The earlier authorized handset destination received a carrier 603 rejection; this does not prove every carrier/destination or that handset now works.
UDP SIP, PCMU RTP and the recorded local NAT mapping; no arbitrary NAT, SRTP, WAN WebRTC, TURN or remote deployment qualification.
preserved_unsuccessful_trials: Initial inbound route before fresh registration: 480 SUBSCRIBER_ABSENT / 503 NORMAL_TEMPORARY_FAILURE, not answered. Fresh registration and a later idle-period retry succeeded. The long-sleep failure cause remains unproven.
First off-account receiver trial clipped the third answer; a second receiver also spoke during response pauses. Neither is a three-turn pass.
The successful receiver uses documented two-second speaking/endpointing delays and a bounded 60-second maximum.

An ordinary code/day question answered the earlier active rehearsal facts; the explicit draft question correctly returned the distinct draft facts. No false claim that every conflicting fact is automatically superseded.
operator_restoration: Saved Telnyx number route and original Vapi assistant assignment are restored and read back after each relevant trial; independent watchdogs guard interrupted rehearsals.
